question: Does Apple's exportedContentTypes(visibility: .all) include representations marked .ownProcess and .team, or only representations whose stored visibility is .all?
reason: Linux returns every export type for .all and filters to an exact match for .team/.ownProcess; the graph does not record the filter rule.

question: Which UTType does Apple's AttributedString.transferRepresentation export (public.rtf, public.rtfd, or public.utf8-plain-text), and does import preserve attributes?
reason: Linux exports UTF-8 of AttributedString.characters as public.utf8-plain-text; RTF/attribute round trips are unobserved.

question: Does Apple encode file URLs as public.file-url via FileRepresentation and internet URLs as public.url, or a single DataRepresentation?
reason: Linux always uses DataRepresentation of absoluteString as public.url; file-copy vs bookmark behavior is unobserved.

question: When is TupleTransferRepresentation.body evaluated on Apple, and what TransferRepresentation does the opaque Body produce?
reason: Linux traps on body and walks builder-captured child nodes instead; composition via body is unobserved.

question: On which queue does NSItemProvider.loadTransferable invoke the completion handler, and what Progress fraction/cancellation identity does it publish?
reason: Linux Foundation has no NSItemProvider; a public substitute is forbidden, so Progress timing cannot be established here.

question: Does TransferRepresentation.visibility(.team) consult the signing team at export time, or is it only a label consulted by the pasteboard/share session?
reason: Linux stores the visibility token and filters exportedContentTypes; it does not talk to a pasteboard, share sheet, or codesigning identity.
